## Find a station
::: {.cgp-panel .cgp-search-card}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
viewof stationQuery = asField(
  Inputs.search(stationsAll, {
    placeholder: "Name, local name, city or region…",
    columns: ["name", "name_local", "city", "region"],
    label: "Search"
  }),
  {inline: true}
)
```

```{ojs}
// The search box and its results share one chunk, and so one card body. Given
// a chunk each, Quarto sized the box's body to 26px and clipped the label and
// the input inside it.
stationResults = {
  const buttons = stationQuery.slice(0, 40).map((row) => {
    const suffix =
      row.status === "active"
        ? ""
        : ` · ${row.status === "closed" ? "closed" : "not listed"}, last seen ${String(
            row.last_seen_utc || ""
          ).slice(0, 10)}`;
    const button = html`<button type="button" data-station-key=${row.station_key}>${row.name}${
      row.name_local ? ` (${row.name_local})` : ""
    } — ${[row.city, row.region, row.country].filter((v) => v).join(", ")}${suffix}</button>`;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => stationChannel.open(row.station_key));
    return button;
  });
  const body = buttons.length
    ? html`<div class="cgp-results">${buttons}</div>`
    : html`<div class="cgp-notice">No station matches.</div>`;
  return html`<div class="cgp-search">${viewof stationQuery}${body}</div>`;
}
```

## Price history
::: {.cgp-panel}

```{ojs}
stationChart = {
  if (!selectedStation) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-notice cgp-station-chart">Search for a station, or open one from
      the Map.</div>`;
  }
  if (!selectedMeta) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-alert cgp-station-chart">Station not found: ${selectedStation}</div>`;
  }
  if (!db) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-notice cgp-station-chart">Loading the price database…</div>`;
  }
  const pick = (row) =>
    perVolume(currency === "USD" ? row.price_usd_per_litre : row.price_local_per_litre, volume);
  const own = stationHistoryRows
    .filter((row) => row.station_key === selectedMeta.station_key)
    .map((row) => ({day: toDay(row.d), grade: row.grade, value: pick(row)}))
    .filter((row) => row.value != null);
  const neighbours = stationHistoryRows
    .filter((row) => row.station_key !== selectedMeta.station_key && row.grade === grade)
    .map((row) => ({day: toDay(row.d), key: row.station_key, value: pick(row)}))
    .filter((row) => row.value != null);
  const medians = stationMedianRows
    .map((row) => ({
      day: toDay(row.d),
      value: perVolume(
        currency === "USD" ? row.median_usd_per_litre : row.median_local_per_litre,
        volume
      )
    }))
    .filter((row) => row.value != null);
  if (!own.length && !medians.length) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-notice cgp-station-chart">No history yet for
      ${selectedMeta.name}.</div>`;
  }
  const medianLabel =
    selectedMeta.region == null
      ? `${COUNTRY_NAMES[selectedMeta.country]} median`
      : `${selectedMeta.region} median`;
  const entry = selectedLatest ? gradeEntry(selectedLatest, grade) : null;
  const unit = currency === "USD" ? "USD" : entry ? entry.currency : "local";
  const figure = Plot.plot({
    width: chartWidth,
    height: 360,
    marginRight: 80,
    style: {background: "transparent", color: palette.text},
    color: {
      legend: true,
      domain: ["regular", "premium", "diesel"],
      range: [palette.ramp[0], palette.ramp[3], palette.ramp[2]]
    },
    x: {label: "Capture date (UTC)", grid: true, ticks: dayTicks(own.concat(medians))},
    y: {label: `${unit} ${volumeLabel}`, grid: true, nice: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(neighbours, {
        x: "day",
        y: "value",
        z: "key",
        stroke: palette.muted,
        strokeOpacity: 0.35
      }),
      // The faint lines were the only unlabelled thing on the chart. One label
      // on the highest of them at its last day says what the whole set is.
      Plot.text(topNeighbour(neighbours), {
        x: "day",
        y: "value",
        text: () => {
          const n = new Set(neighbours.map((row) => row.key)).size;
          return n === 1 ? "nearest station" : `nearest ${n} stations`;
        },
        dx: 6,
        dy: -8,
        textAnchor: "start",
        fill: palette.muted
      }),
      Plot.line(medians, {
        x: "day",
        y: "value",
        stroke: palette.muted,
        strokeDasharray: "4 3",
        strokeWidth: 2
      }),
      Plot.text(medians.slice(-1), {
        x: "day",
        y: "value",
        text: () => medianLabel,
        dx: 6,
        textAnchor: "start",
        fill: palette.muted
      }),
      Plot.line(own, {x: "day", y: "value", z: "grade", stroke: "grade", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(own, {
        x: "day",
        y: "value",
        z: "grade",
        fill: "grade",
        r: 3
      }),
      // Last, so it paints over the median label rather than under it.
      Plot.tip(
        own,
        Plot.pointer({
          x: "day",
          y: "value",
          ...tipStyle(),
          title: (row) =>
            `${selectedMeta.name} · ${row.day.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}\n` +
            `${GRADE_LABELS[row.grade] || row.grade} ${fmtNumber(row.value, priceDigits)} ` +
            `${unit}${volumeShort}`
        })
      )
    ]
  });
  return html`<div class="cgp-station-chart">${figure}</div>`;
}
```

## Station detail
::: {.cgp-panel}

```{ojs}
stationDetail = {
  if (!selectedStation) return html`<div class="cgp-notice">Nothing selected.</div>`;
  if (!selectedMeta) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-alert">Station not found: ${selectedStation}</div>`;
  }
  const entries = selectedLatest
    ? [
        ...["regular", "premium", "diesel"]
          .filter((key) => gradeEntry(selectedLatest, key))
          .map((key) => [GRADE_LABELS[key], gradeEntry(selectedLatest, key)]),
        ...Object.entries(selectedLatest.other || {})
      ]
    : [];
  const rows = entries.map(
    ([label, entry]) => html`<tr>
      <td>${label}</td>
      <td>${entry.price_raw} ${entry.price_unit}</td>
      <td class="cgp-num">${fmtNumber(perVolume(entry.price_local_per_litre, volume), priceDigits)}
        ${entry.currency}${volumeShort}</td>
      <td class="cgp-num">${fmtNumber(perVolume(entry.price_usd_per_litre, volume), priceDigits)}
        USD${volumeShort}</td>
    </tr>`
  );
  const links = [];
  if (selectedMeta.superseded_by) {
    links.push(html`<div class="cgp-notice">Superseded by
      <a href=${stationHref(selectedMeta.superseded_by)}>${
        selectedMeta.superseded_by
      }</a>.</div>`);
  }
  for (const row of stationsAll.filter((s) => s.superseded_by === selectedMeta.station_key)) {
    links.push(html`<div class="cgp-notice">Supersedes
      <a href=${stationHref(row.station_key)}>${
        row.station_key
      }</a>.</div>`);
  }
  const neighbours = nearestStations.map(
    (row) => html`<li><a href=${stationHref(row.station_key)}>${
      row.name
    }</a> <span class="cgp-stale">${row.km.toFixed(0)} km</span></li>`
  );
  return html`<div>
    <div class="cgp-popup-title">${selectedMeta.name}${
      selectedMeta.name_local
        ? html` <span class="cgp-local">${selectedMeta.name_local}</span>`
        : ""
    }</div>
    <div class="cgp-popup-place">${[
      selectedMeta.city,
      selectedMeta.region,
      COUNTRY_NAMES[selectedMeta.country]
    ]
      .filter((v) => v)
      .join(", ")} · ${selectedMeta.station_key}</div>
    <table class="cgp-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Grade</th><th>As published</th>
        <th class="cgp-num">Local</th><th class="cgp-num">USD</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="cgp-notice">First seen ${String(selectedMeta.first_seen_utc || "").slice(0, 10)},
      last seen ${String(selectedMeta.last_seen_utc || "").slice(0, 10)}.
      ${statusSentence(selectedMeta)}</div>
    ${rateNote(selectedLatest)}
    ${links}
    ${stationLinksEl(selectedMeta)}
    <div class="cgp-notice">Nearest active stations:</div>
    <ul class="cgp-notice">${neighbours}</ul>
  </div>`;
}
```

## Recent price changes
::: {.cgp-panel .cgp-chart-card}

```{ojs}
stationChanges = {
  if (!selectedMeta) return html`<div class="cgp-notice">Nothing selected.</div>`;
  if (!db) return html`<div class="cgp-notice">Loading the price database…</div>`;
  const own = stationHistoryRows.filter((row) => row.station_key === selectedMeta.station_key);
  const changes = priceChanges(own, 30);
  if (!changes.length) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-notice">No price change recorded yet for
      ${selectedMeta.name}. Its prices have held for every day collected so far.</div>`;
  }
  const rows = changes.map((change) => {
    const delta = change.to - change.from;
    const pct = change.from > 0 ? (delta / change.from) * 100 : null;
    const unit = currency === "USD" ? "USD" : change.currency;
    const from = currency === "USD" ? change.fromUsd : change.from;
    const to = currency === "USD" ? change.toUsd : change.to;
    return html`<tr>
      <td>${change.d}</td>
      <td>${GRADE_LABELS[change.grade] || change.grade}</td>
      <td class="cgp-num">${fmtNumber(perVolume(from, volume), priceDigits)}</td>
      <td class="cgp-num">${fmtNumber(perVolume(to, volume), priceDigits)} ${unit}${volumeShort}</td>
      <td class=${"cgp-num " + (delta > 0 ? "cgp-up" : "cgp-down")}>${
        delta > 0 ? "▲" : "▼"
      } ${pct == null ? "—" : fmtPct(pct)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  });
  return html`<div>
    <table class="cgp-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Day</th><th>Grade</th><th class="cgp-num">From</th>
        <th class="cgp-num">To</th><th class="cgp-num">Change</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="cgp-notice">The day a new price was first seen, not necessarily the day it
      changed: a station is read a few times a day, and only while it is open.</div>
  </div>`;
}
```
